preconditions.description: Number of cities is within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n - 1 and all(1 <= p[i] < i for i in range(1, n))
preconditions.description: Road connections are valid and form a tree structure.
Number of bus routes is within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in bus_routes)
preconditions.description: Bus routes are valid and do not connect a city to itself.
Number of questions is within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n and v != u for v, u in queries)
preconditions.description: Queries are valid and do not ask about traveling to the same city.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
all(result == -1 or result >= 1 for result in results)
postconditions.description: If a path exists, the number of buses is at least 1; otherwise, it is -1.

postconditions.expression: all(results[i] == min_buses(v, u) for i, (v, u) in enumerate(queries))
postconditions.description: Each result corresponds to the minimum number of buses needed for the query.
